steps.name: reply-language

Instructions: chosen language is only where to start, then the user's latest own words; a tapped label is not their words. Live: languageCodes = AI language + ko-KR + en-US (SDK field is a list). Phone: choices.ts tables in all 9 languages, optional `language` on choiceQuestion/choiceLabel/declineLabel, Choices.tsx uses useAiText; FIXED_LABELS exported. Eval: tapChoice turn kind, cases l-ko-on-en-tap and l-ko-voice-like-en, 2/2 Korean on backend auto (evals/results/2026-10-15T09-03, listed in NUMBERS.md partial runs). New unit tests failed before the change (ownWords, chat, live, instructions; choices tests were written after its tables). Voice NOT verified: one npm run test:e2e:live, 8 passed / 9 failed; both hero-ko runs filled the cart but showed no Hangul AI bubble within 20 s (I-272, open; check now reports bubbles/hangul/latin); 6 text tests failed on upstream deadlines and a 429 (I-157). Voice evidence files restored to the commit, counts in NUMBERS.md (36 attempted, 25 passed). R-020 (proposed) added: wrong-reply-language reached 3 (I-256, I-269, I-271). Docs: ARCHITECTURE, UX, TESTING, ISSUE (I-271–I-273, I-099 seen).

steps.name: order-care
steps.summary: Swap: src/lib/agent/swap.ts (carryOver, swapTracker), used by runChat and the voice runToolCalls: within one request/tool batch, the first addToCart after exactly one line went out (removeFromCart, or undoLastChange that took one line out) gets that line's single/set and options for groups the model left out, only where the new item+variant has the group and the option and it is not sold out; a group the model names (even empty) is kept; actions record the args really sent. Cross-request swaps rely on a new instruction line. Instructions: never say added/prepared/changed before the tool succeeded; food kiosks get '## Allergies and health' (allergens of every line incl. a set's side and drink items, empty list = none listed, cross-contact unknown, never 'safe', then offerChoices ask_staff + {staff}). New template ask_staff in errors.ts, schemas.ts, tools.ts, choices.ts (9 languages, [No thanks] decline). Eval: ChoicesExpect.templateId optional; cases c-ko-swap-keeps-choices, r-en-allergy-staff, r-ko-allergy-staff 3/3 on backend auto (evals/results/2026-10-15T09-37, listed in NUMBERS.md partial runs; whether model or server carried the swap is not recorded). New unit tests failed before the change. Docs: ARCHITECTURE (Agent tools), UX exceptions, PRD allergens row, ISSUE I-274-I-276.
